newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell wins Rayong gasoline tender at -70 cts/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Shell wins Rayong gasoline tender at -70 cts/bbl.

text.p: Thai refiner Rayong Refinery Co Ltd has awarded a tender to sell 180,000-barrels of 92-octane unleaded gasoline to Shell Singapore at 70 cents per barrel below Singapore quotes on a free-on-board basis, industry sources said on Friday.
The tender for the cargo lifting June 23-27 from Map Ta Phut on the eastern seaboard closed Friday and was valid for the same time.
The 145,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery is a joint venture between the Royal Dutch Shell Group and the Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT).
The Rayong refinery just restarted its 30,000 bpd reformer on June 19 Thursday after a 10-day maintenance shutdown, sources close to the company said on Thursday.
